text.title: In The Balance
text.declared_mood: Uneasy restraint → orbiting tension → surrender and collapse
text.production_notes: Deep sub bass pulses like orbital gravity, Dub-style delays that drift and return unpredictably, Sparse percussion with off-kilter rimshots and distant kicks, Metallic and glassy synths early on, Gradual warming of harmonic layers, Filter sweeps mimicking approach and retreat, Panning elements circling the stereo field, Reverb tails elongate with emotional escalation, Final drop introduces distortion, saturated bass, and widened stereo chaos
text.vocal_notes: Close, intimate androgynous vocal, breath-heavy phrasing, fragile upper register in verses, restrained delivery as if holding something back, subtle delay tails pulling phrases away, doubled whispers panned wide, low octave shadow vocal creeping in during pre-hooks, soaring hooks, final section breaks restraint with layered, raw intensity
section_names: Intro – distant pulses | high, cold synths | orbital movement
Verse 1 – minimal beat | tense spacing | ticking rhythm
Pre-Hook – rising resonance | slow filter swell
Hook – warm bass enters | wider space
Verse 2 – dub echoes | wider gaps | moving stereo field
Hook – fuller low end | harmonies bloom slightly
Bridge – dub breakdown | echo fragments | spoken layers
Build – rising tension | accelerating delay repeats | tightening loop
Drop – explosive bass | distortion | widened chaos
Final Verse / Release – full instrumentation | raw vocal layers
Outro – collapsing echoes | fading low-end | unresolved chord

segments.text: I trace your light from far away
I'm not cold enough to turn to stone
I'm not close enough to burn away
I keep a path I've always known
I measure distance in my range
In micro shifts I can't arrange
Too much weight and it might shred
I read the silence in your tone
And I stay within the range
Not too near, not too gone
In the balance I remain so glint
Through pulling strain in your orbit

I soften edges of my voice
Like presence is a measured choice
Just enough to let you breathe
But if you fade beyond my sight
I feel the pull to realize
A fragile zone I orbit through
Defined by you, defined by you
In the balance I remain so glint
Through pulling strain in your orbit
If I stay I'm too severe
There's a line I cannot see
But I feel it pulling me closer
If I cross it something breaks
If I don't, it slowly aches
I was never meant to stay there still

I feel the flame no safe
But for once I don't retreat
Pass the place I used to bend
I accept the way I burn
If I vanish let it be
No more distance left to hold
No more careful no more control
